''See also: [[Zenith Colony Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] [[Colony]] is one of seven legendary [[Zenith Devices]], which are highly valuable artifacts created in the distant past to foster galactic expansion and civilization. While many scholars previously doubted its existence, it is a sentient entity capable of vocal communication, often speaking with a male voice or through the violet-colored sky. Physically, it can manifest as a small, obsidian crystal or stone roughly the size of a human head, but it is also capable of expanding into a massive structure. As a hidden city in space, the [[Colony]] serves as a refuge for inhabitants and possesses an internal system capable of containing entire star systems under a violet sky. It is also used to house various assets, including fleets of ships and potentially rebel armies.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The [[Zenith]] [[Colony]] manifests as a massive obsidian cube filled with purple light, containing an interior that resembles a fractured kaleidoscope of amethyst shards. After various ships spill out from its structure, the colony demonstrates the ability to fold itself into a stone no larger than a human head. During its time floating near [[Starhammer]]'s head, the entity served as a location that aided his investigation and provided a space where combat could continue. Although it possesses specific capabilities that are difficult to comprehend precisely, the colony failed to respond when [[Starhammer]] called for the [[Shadow Ark]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Also known as the [[Shadow Ark]], the [[Zenith]] [[Colony]] is a significant entity observed by [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. During their encounter, the colony communicated directly with him, and its presence was later sensed by [[Horizon]]. The entity's voice originates from the violet-edged sky, and it serves as a key component of the group with which [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] must coordinate.}}
